reviews.title: F1 Predict not working
reviews.text:
I love this app and have been using it for years but this year, the Fantasy side of the app has taken a massive decline in usability and user experience. To start with, Predict is no longer available in the app and we are now having to use the app for Fantasy and an incognito browser for Predict which is just a hassle. The browser also keeps crashing and you can’t view your predictions or they don’t save. People are struggling to join our leagues and it’s ruining the whole experience of having a competitive league amongst our friends. 

The Fantasy experience in the app has also changed and not for the good. When viewing leagues and results from races, instead of the standard view like when you select your own teams, you now have a list of your drivers and teams which is just not as user friendly, it should have the same consistency as the team selection page. 

Please fix the Predict within the app! It’s super frustrating when this all used to work seamlessly together last year!

reviews.title: It could have been 4 stars
reviews.text:
I would have rated the app a 4 star, since I had only one minor negative comment and a lot of positive takes about it. However I took the opportunity to send them a feedback about what I dislike. I went through the feedback form, provided my feedback in detail, and when I reached the end of the form, the “finish” button did not work. It was enabled (not greyed out) but nothing happened once hit. Useless, waste of my time and obviously frustrating.
BTW, here is the minor suggestion I was meant to leave in my feedback:

I think what needs to improve is to remove the highlight of the first row in the timesheets and race standings. There is no point to highlight the first position in a different colour. At first you actually get the opposite result, since the eye recognises the first line in a different colour as the table header rader than the first position and it goes straight to the second position instead, skipping the first one for a few seconds, before realising it. It would be easier to keep the list with no highlight to the first line: it’s obvious that the name on the top of the list is the first position. Isn’t it?

reviews.title: They ruined it
reviews.text:
I used to absolutely love the F1 app it was genuinely one of the best ways to follow the races, check timings, and stay updated. But after the recent update, it feels like they’ve completely lost what made it great. The layout is clunky, everything takes more taps than it should, and some of the features that used to be quick and reliable now feel slow or buried.

It’s frustrating because it was brilliant, and now it just feels over-designed and less user-friendly. I really hope they listen to the feedback and bring back the simplicity and speed the old version had. Until then, it’s honestly gone from a must-have to a bit of a disappointment.
